meta.title: AI Coding Plan & Token Plan Tracker

vendors.name: Cursor
vendors.billing: credit pool + usage multiplier; Auto mode unlimited (no credit burn)
vendors.notes: Bugbot code review add-on $20 (Pro) / $40 (Teams). Non-Auto agent requests add $0.25/MTok Cursor Token fee. Native iOS app in beta (Jul 2026).

vendors.name: Claude Code
vendors.billing: via Claude subscription or API per token (no standalone sub)
vendors.notes: Usage capped by 5h rolling window + weekly cap (shared across chat/Code/Cowork). Opus-specific weekly limit removed; Sonnet has extra ceiling. May 2026 doubled Claude Code 5h limits (SpaceX compute deal). Planned move of programmatic usage (Agent SDK / claude -p) to separate API credits on 2026-06-15 was PAUSED before launch.

vendors.name: GitHub Copilot
vendors.billing: GitHub AI Credits (1 credit = $0.01), token-metered since 2026-06-01
vendors.notes: First full billing cycle closed 2026-06-30: heavy agentic seats saw 10x-50x bill surge ($600-3000/mo). Completions & Next Edit remain unlimited/free. Model menu spread ~60x. First-party MAI-Code-1-Flash ($0.75/$4.50) cheapest. Monthly subs auto-switched 6/1; annual subs keep old pricing until renewal.

vendors.name: OpenAI Codex
vendors.notes: WAU >5M. Heavy real cost ~$100-200/dev/mo. Token rate card GPT-5.5 125/12.5/750 credits per MTok.

vendors.name: Windsurf / Devin Desktop
vendors.notes: Tab completions always free/unlimited. Quota resets daily/weekly; sprint bursts can hit caps. Kept flat pricing -> attracting Copilot migration.

vendors.name: Trae
vendors.billing: token-based since 2026-02-24 (Basic + Bonus Usage; On-Demand overflow)
vendors.notes: Cheapest in category; SOLO multi-agent parallelism; ~25% off annual.

vendors.name: Gemini Code Assist
vendors.notes: Gemini CLI free tier: 1,000 requests/day, open-source Apache 2.0, Google Search grounding.
